explanation: Generate enough independent fair bits to cover the range size. Reject bit patterns outside the requested range and retry; conditioning on acceptance leaves every valid offset equally likely. A one-value range needs no random bits.
timeComplexity: O(log R) expected time for R possible values; fewer than two attempts on average.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space for the fixed-width integer range.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
